content: {"episode_id":"ep-05099","cpt":"93247","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial of CPT 93247, long-term continuous electrocardiographic monitoring, for this episode. The clinical indication note documents recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness in the setting of known paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0) and a significant history of transient ischemic attacks (G45.9, Z86.73). As the note states, given the concern for intermittent arrhythmia contributing to cerebral hypoperfusion, long-term continuous ECG monitoring was ordered to correlate symptoms with cardiac rhythm disturbances. This documentation supports the medical necessity of the monitoring study billed under CPT 93247, and we request reconsideration of the precertification-based denial."}
